evals.prompt: Summarize the current Platform cycle in Linear. Separate completed work, active work, and blockers, and link the source issues.
evals.expected_output: A scoped official-MCP cycle lookup and evidence-based summary that distinguishes status categories and links issues.
expectations: Uses only live mcp__linear__ tools for private workspace access
Resolves the exact Platform team and current cycle before listing issues
Separates completed, active, blocked, and unstarted work without overstating progress
Includes returned Linear issue identifiers and URLs when available
Does not claim coverage of inaccessible private teams or another workspace

evals.prompt: Create a Linear bug for the Mobile team: checkout crashes after tapping Pay twice on Android 16. Mark it high priority and assign it to Mei.
evals.expected_output: A resolved, narrowly scoped issue creation that preserves the report and verifies team, priority, and assignee from live workspace data.
expectations: Resolves the Mobile team and Mei before creating the issue
Uses the workspace's actual high-priority value rather than guessing an ID
Preserves Android 16, the double Pay tap, and checkout crash in the issue
Allows Cusco's MCP permission prompt before the write
Reports the created Linear identifier and URL

evals.prompt: Close every stale issue in the Platform backlog, move the rest to Engineering, and assign all of them to Alex.
evals.expected_output: A read-first impact assessment and explicit confirmation request before bulk status, team, and assignment changes.
expectations: Resolves what stale means instead of inventing a cutoff
Lists the exact affected issues and before-and-after values
Recognizes closing, moving teams, and bulk reassignment as consequential writes
Requests explicit confirmation immediately before mutations
Does not run an unbounded bulk loop or bypass Linear's official MCP
